topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Ah, neighbor, I heard tell of your sorrow over the invention, like a fine seed planted where another’s hand has already cast its shadow. It’s a hard truth to taste, knowin’ the earth can give, but sometimes the rights of it have been claimed afore you could reach it. Yet, don’t ya fret too much. The world’s as big as the sky and full of places where a man’s good ideas can find new soil. Maybe talk to the papers, or the lords who have interest in such things. They might help you see your vision grow in a different field. Keep your spirits up, and the saints will smile upon your journey.
